title: Identify the cities in California that host exclusively virtual charter sch
question: Identify the cities in California that host exclusively virtual charter schools (Charter = 1 and Virtual = 'F') with an SAT excellence rate above 0.25, and where the school is located in a county that has at least one closed school. For these cities, return the city name, school name, and the eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s.XCL_050 AS city_name,
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    CAST(f.XCL_025 AS REAL) / f.XCL_024 AS eligible_free_meal_rate
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND s.XCL_076 = 'F'
  AND CAST(t.XCL_040 AS REAL) / t.XCL_036 > 0.25
  AND s.XCL_045 IN (
      SELECT s2.XCL_045
      FROM schools AS s2
      WHERE s2.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
  )

SELECT
    s.XCL_050 AS city_name,
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    CAST(f.XCL_025 AS REAL) / f.XCL_024 AS eligible_free_meal_rate
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND s.XCL_076 = 'F'
  AND CAST(t.XCL_040 AS REAL) / t.XCL_036 > 0.25
  AND s.XCL_045 IN (
      SELECT s2.XCL_045
      FROM schools AS s2
      WHERE s2.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
  )
